To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TIFR to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TIFR to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TIFR Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the TIFR Project Associate positions is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Associate position announced by TIFR.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Biological Sciences with relevant research experience to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 35,000 per month, plus HRA, depending on NET qualification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the TIFR Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the TIFR Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening of applications followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for the TIFR Project Associate positions through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q9. Where is TIFR located?
faq.answer: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this TIFR Project Associate recruitment is 2026/25.
